name: Forsythe Walks to the Elevators
description: Forsythe walks through the darkened and deserted reception area toward the elevators. Through the main doors, a delivery van is parked in the driveway.
related_events: Forsythe walks to the elevators through the darkened reception area

name: Doorman Opens Doors and Greets Tudor
description: The doorman opens both doors as Tudor approaches the building. 'Afternoon, Mr. Tudor,' he says.
related_events: Doorman opens building doors for Tudor
Doorman greets Tudor upon arrival

name: Merrick Shows Benda a Floor Plan
description: Merrick and the Svibens sit across from each other at a long table covered with floor plans and maps. The river surrounding the complex flows outside the glass walls of the office. Merrick taps one of the plans with his finger, then slides it toward Benda. 'Now you take a look at that one, Brenda,' he says, 'and tell me if it doesn't suit you down to the ground. That one has the big view, the panoramic view.'
related_events: Merrick presents a floor plan to Benda during a meeting

name: Janine Enters the Room
description: Janine walks down the hallway, stops at a door, and knocks gently. She opens the door and walks in, moving with the ease of someone who has been in the room many times before.
related_events: Janine knocks on the door gently
Janine opens the door and enters the room

name: Forsythe Prepares Parkins for the Doctor
description: Forsythe enters the examination room and hands Parkins a hospital tunic. He tells Parkins to remove his clothes, put on the tunic, and get onto the table, adding that the doctor will arrive shortly. As Forsythe turns to leave, Parkins says he doesn’t need to go, remarking that he isn’t shy. Forsythe replies not to be a tease, reminding him he’s still working, then exits the room. Parkins chuckles quietly to himself and begins taking off his clothes.
related_events: Forsythe hands Parkins a hospital tunic and instructs him to change
Forsythe declines to stay and leaves the examination room
Parkins tells Forsythe he does not need to leave
Parkins chuckles and begins to undress

name: Forsythe Calls Mr. Parkins into the Examination Room
description: Forsythe steps out from an examination room into the reception area, looks over the patient list, and calls out to Mr. Parkins. Mr. Parkins stands up and walks behind Forsythe into the examination room.
related_events: Forsythe calls Mr. Parkins into the examination room
Mr. Parkins follows Forsythe into the examination room

name: Forsythe Smiles, St. Luc Looks Away
description: Forsythe catches St. Luc watching her as she dresses and smiles. St. Luc swivels back to his files.
related_events: Forsythe notices St. Luc watching her dress and reacts with a smile
St. Luc turns away from Forsythe back to his files

name: Tudor Arrives at the Towers by Cab
description: The cab carrying Tudor pulls up at the main doors of the Towers. Tudor signs a chit and hands it to the driver. He opens the door and steps out, moving unsteadily as he leaves the cab behind.
related_events: Tudor arrives at the Towers by cab
Tudor signs payment chit for cab driver
Tudor exits the cab at the Towers

name: Janine Buys a Magazine and Leaves Without Groceries
description: Janine walks into the grocery store at the base of the tower and flips through a few magazines before buying a copy of Vogue. She moves through the aisles, stopping at several shelves and picking up different food items. After a moment, she sets them back down and walks out of the store, carrying only the magazine.
related_events: Janine buys a Vogue magazine in the grocery store
Janine abandons intention to buy food due to repulsion

name: St. Luc Flips Through Hobbes's Publications While Forsythe Removes Her Stockings
description: St. Luc shuffles through Hobbes's publications, pages turning under his fingers. Across the room, Forsythe begins rolling down her stockings, the fabric sliding slowly over her skin. He looks up and says, 'OK, I bite. What does it look like?'
related_events: St. Luc shuffles through Hobbes's publications
Forsythe rolls down her stockings
St. Luc asks Forsythe what something looks like

name: Tudor Vomits on the Balcony
description: Tudor stands on the narrow concrete balcony, gripping the railing as he gasps for air and stares at the lights of the tower across. His neck stiffens, his mouth opening wide as if wrenched open by force. His hands fly to his face, pressing against his mouth, but he can't hold it back. Bent over the railing, he retches violently, gagging and moaning before finally vomiting into the space below. He remains there, clutching the railing, breathing heavily as the spasm passes.
related_events: Tudor experiences sudden physical distress on the balcony
Tudor vomits over the balcony railing

name: Kurt Delivers Serving Cart with Doorman's Help
description: Kurt, the delivery boy from Restaurant Côte d'Azur, approached the building's main entrance pushing a serving cart laden with silver vessels and utensils. The doorman, recognizing him, smiled and opened the doors. Kurt carefully lifted the cart to clear the doormats before rolling it inside.
related_events: Kurt delivers restaurant serving cart to building entrance
Doorman opens main doors for Kurt
Kurt lifts serving cart over doormats

name: Tudor Steps Onto the Balcony After Illness
description: Tudor walks into the living room from the bathroom, wiping his mouth with a facecloth. He sits down on a chair facing the sliding glass door, breathing heavily and mumbling incoherently. After a moment, he stands up, opens the glass door, and steps out onto the balcony.
related_events: Tudor exits bathroom and enters living room while wiping his mouth
Tudor sits on chair facing balcony door and struggles to breathe
Tudor rises and steps onto the balcony

name: Tudor Enters Annabelle's Apartment
description: Tudor inserted the key into the lock of Annabelle's apartment door and turned it. He knocked gently, then waited a moment before pushing the door open. After stepping inside, he pulled the door shut behind him.
related_events: Tudor unlocks Annabelle's apartment door with a key
Tudor knocks on Annabelle's apartment door
Tudor enters Annabelle's apartment
Tudor closes the apartment door behind him

name: St. Luc Finishes Exam and Leaves Dotty to Get Dressed
description: St. Luc finishes examining Dotty and tells her to come back if she experiences any sharp pain or unusual discharge. Dotty nods. He tells her she can get dressed. She begins putting her clothes on. St. Luc writes something in her file, then takes the file with him into the adjoining office and closes the door behind him.
related_events: St. Luc completes medical examination of Dotty
Dotty begins getting dressed after examination
St. Luc records notes in Dotty's file and moves to adjoining office

name: Kresimir and Benda Arrive at Starliner Towers
description: A car approaches Starliner Towers and comes to a stop near the main doors of the West Tower. Kresimir and Benda Sviben step out, the newly married couple moving together with their hands clasped. Kresimir opens the car door for Benda with an elaborate gesture before they walk up the steps of the West Tower, side by side.
related_events: Kresimir and Benda Sviben arrive at Starliner Towers
Kresimir opens the door for Benda
Kresimir and Benda walk hand in hand up the steps

name: Rollo and St. Luc Prepare for the Encounter at Ten
description: St. Luc arranges to meet one of the creatures at ten o'clock. Rollo decides to join him, expressing concern about how quickly the creatures can become uncontrollable. He warns that once they start releasing chemicals into the bloodstream, there’s little time to react. If St. Luc sees people acting strangely, especially in sexual or compulsive ways, Rollo suggests using tranquilizers. He promises to bring a bag of supplies, enough to handle the situation, but notes the difficulty will be getting close enough to use them.
related_events: St. Luc arranges a meeting with one of the creatures at ten o'clock
Rollo agrees to join St. Luc for the encounter
Rollo expresses concern about the dangerous design of the creatures
Rollo suggests using tranquilizers on the creatures
Rollo offers to bring a medical kit for the creatures

name: Rollo Explains a Cryptic Quote
description: Rollo repeats a phrase describing a disease meant to save man from his mind. St. Luc, hearing it, says he doesn't understand. Rollo tells him he will explain. He takes a moment to wash down a bite of knish with a swig of Coca-Cola before continuing.
related_events: Rollo quotes description of a disease
St. Luc expresses confusion
Rollo attempts to clarify the quote
Rollo drinks Coca-Cola while eating knish

name: Rollo Discovers Hobbes's Deception
description: In the lab, Rollo sits on a gynecological table that he has repurposed as a desk. Around him are open waxed-paper packages of beef knishes, which he eats from while shuffling through stacks of papers. The documents came from Hobbes’s mother, who received them after Hobbes’s death and sent the medical-related ones to Rollo, Hobbes’s lab partner. Cardboard shoeboxes, some still tied with string, spill over with handwritten notes and loose pages. As Rollo reads through the material, he finds evidence that Hobbes had been deceiving the university, research foundations, private labs, and even his colleagues. The notes reveal a pattern of fraud and strange, erratic behavior that Hobbes had kept hidden.
related_events: Hobbes's personal secret materials are sent to his mother after his death
Hobbes's mother sends medical-related materials to Rollo at the lab
Rollo reviews Hobbes's papers and discovers his betrayal
Rollo discovers extent of Hobbes's unusual behavior
Rollo eats beef knish while reviewing Hobbes's notes
Rollo uses gynecological table as auxiliary desk

name: Janine Waits in the Living Room
description: Janine sits on the couch, flipping agitatedly through a copy of Vogue. She wears large, fashionable glasses with thick, tinted lenses. After a moment, she sets the magazine aside, stands up, and turns on the television. She adjusts the volume to a level that fills the room, the sound harsh and loud, then remains seated, her attention unfixed.
related_events: Janine flips through Vogue magazine while wearing large fashionable glasses
Janine turns on the TV and increases the volume to an uncomfortable level

name: Nicholas Tudor on the Bed with Moving Lumps Beneath His Skin
description: Nicholas Tudor lies flat on his back on the bed, fully clothed atop the covers. His face is pale and sunken, resembling a corpse, yet his expression is serene and rapturous, almost saintly. His hands rest on his abdomen near his navel, where three distinct lumps shift and pulse under the skin, changing position slowly. As they move, he makes soft, crooning sounds, half-mumbled and singsong, like a distorted lullaby.
related_events: Nicholas Tudor lies motionless on bed with lumps moving under his skin

name: Tudor Leaves His Apartment and Walks to the Elevator
description: Tudor steps out of his apartment and pulls the door shut behind him, the number on the door visible in the frame. He moves down the hallway without looking around, his steps steady but distant, as if his mind is elsewhere. He rounds the corner toward the elevators, pauses briefly in front of the control panel, and presses the UP button. The elevator doors open, and he steps inside.
related_events: Tudor leaves his apartment and closes the door
Tudor walks down the hallway on automatic pilot

name: Tudor Calls and Enters the Elevator
description: Tudor reaches the elevator, pauses for a moment, and presses the UP button. The elevator arrives, the doors open, and he steps inside.
related_events: Tudor presses the UP button at the elevator
Tudor enters the elevator after the door opens

name: St. Luc Reveals Hobbes' Death and Discovers Abdominal Growths
description: St. Luc stands in the room, the Velakofsky file in hand, flipping through abdominal X-rays that show dark, blurred masses within the abdominal cavity. Forsythe is halfway into her street clothes, moving quietly in the background. St. Luc speaks to Rollo. Hobbes didn't make it, he says. He didn't know it, but Annabelle was well known at Starliner Towers. Now, St. Luc has found three men, possibly four, each with large, unidentifiable growths in their abdomen—free-moving, unexplained, and seemingly pathogenic. He’s tried reaching others for answers, but none can identify what the masses are. Rollo’s name comes up. You were next on my list.
related_events: St. Luc informs Rollo that Hobbes did not survive
St. Luc examines abdominal X-rays from the Velakofsky file
St. Luc identifies multiple individuals with unexplained abdominal growths

name: Forsythe Dresses to Leave
description: St. Luc watches as Forsythe pulls on her street clothes, moving slowly through the motions of dressing. She buttons her coat, adjusts her sleeves, and gathers her belongings, preparing to leave the room.
related_events: Forsythe begins dressing in street clothes

name: Betts Suggests a Surprise Doctor Visit for Nick
description: Janine sits on a bench in the sauna, a towel wrapped around her head and torso. Betts, seated beside her, listens as Janine expresses concern about Nick’s health. Betts dismisses the symptoms as likely harmless, suggesting the lumps might be fatty cysts that can be easily removed. When Janine says Nick refuses to see doctors, Betts proposes a plan: Janine should go to the clinic and tell Dr. St. Luc that Nick is too ill to leave bed, urging him to make a house call when Nick will be home. She instructs Janine not to tell Nick, so the doctor can confront him directly. Janine smiles faintly, pleased at the thought of Nick being upset. Betts stretches out on the bench, her toes brushing against Benda Sviben, who is sitting huddled in a corner. Noticing her for the first time, Betts apologizes and greets her. Benda pulls her towel tighter, offering a nervous smile in response.
related_events: Betts gives Janine advice about Tudor's disease
Betts suggests deceiving Nick by arranging a surprise doctor visit
Janine reacts with quiet satisfaction to Betts's deceptive plan

name: Betts Notices Benda in the Sauna
description: After stretching out on the bench, Betts' toes brush against Benda's thigh. She turns and sees Benda huddled in the corner, wrapped tightly in her towel. 'Oops, sorry. Hi. Haven't seen you here before, have I?' she says. Benda flinches slightly, pulls her towel more closely around her, and offers a small, nervous smile in response.
related_events: Betts acknowledges Benda for the first time during the sauna gathering
Benda responds nervously to Betts's sudden attention

name: Dr. St. Luc Calls Janine Tudor into His Office
description: Dr. St. Luc stood at the end of the hallway, glancing down at the list of patients who had signed in. He looked up and gestured toward Janine Tudor, who was seated beside Mr. Parkins. Janine rose from her chair, turning to Parkins and saying, 'Excuse me, Brad. Gotta go.' She walked down the hall and followed Dr. St. Luc into his office. He stepped in after her and closed the door behind them.
related_events: Dr. St. Luc reviews patient sign-in list
Dr. St. Luc gestures for Janine Tudor to follow into his office
Janine Tudor excuses herself from conversation with Mr. Parkins
Janine Tudor follows Dr. St. Luc into his office
Dr. St. Luc closes office door after entering with Janine Tudor
related_occasions: Clinic Patient Appointments At Starliner Towers Medical Clinic

name: Mr. Parkins Talks with Janine in the Waiting Room
description: In the waiting area of the Starliner Towers Medical Clinic, Mr. Parkins sits with Janine Tudor, speaking animatedly about aging and mega-vitamin therapy. He mentions a man named Kriedler, who believes such therapy might halt the aging process, though not reverse it. Parkins clarifies that he doesn't think aging can be reversed, but suggests it might be stoppable. As he continues the conversation, Dr. St. Luc appears, checks the patient list, and gestures for Janine to follow him. She stands, excuses herself to Parkins, and enters the doctor's office. He closes the door behind them.
related_events: Mr. Parkins converses with Janine Tudor in waiting area
related_occasions: Clinic Patient Appointments At Starliner Towers Medical Clinic

name: Tudor Finds the Bodies of Annabelle and Hobbes
description: Tudor steps into the apartment and immediately smells smoke and burned flesh. He moves toward the bedroom but stops when he sees Hobbes's foot extending from around the corner of the dining room. Covering his nose and mouth, he approaches cautiously. Annabelle's body lies on the dining table, still smoking, her eyes open, a surgical clip attached to her lips, bruises visible on her neck. Hobbes is curled on the floor beneath the table, one hand gripping a scalpel embedded in his neck, blood pooling beneath him. Tudor winces, blinks rapidly, and edges around the room until he can see Annabelle's face clearly. He turns away, his body tensing as he retches, then straightens with effort and stumbles toward the door. He grabs his attaché case and closes the door behind him as he leaves.
related_events: Tudor discovers Annabelle's and Hobbes's bodies in the apartment
Tudor reacts to the gruesome scene with physical distress

name: Tudor Identifies Annabelle's Body
description: Tudor edges around the room, shifting his position until he can see the head of the corpse on the table. It is Annabelle, her eyes still open, a surgical clip attached to her lips, and purple bruises visible on her neck. He stares at the body, taking in the details, then turns away, his body tensing as he fights back a wave of nausea.
related_events: Tudor identifies Annabelle's body with surgical clip and neck bruises

name: Tudor Leaves the Apartment
description: Tudor blinked rapidly, moving carefully around the dining room to avoid looking directly at the bodies. After seeing Annabelle's face on the table, he turned away, his body tensing as he fought nausea. He straightened up, took a shaky breath, and walked toward the door. He picked up his attaché case from where it had been left by the entrance, then closed the door behind him before leaving the apartment.
related_events: Tudor staggers away from the crime scene with his attaché case

name: The Svibens Arrive and Seek the Rental Agent
description: The Svibens approach the main doors of the building. The doorman, a man in his fifties of average height and slight build, wearing thick glasses, quickly rises from his chair beside the intercom switchboard and opens the door for them. Kresimir thanks him and says they are looking for the rental agent, mentioning they have an appointment. The doorman nods and reaches for the intercom, pressing a button to call the agent. As he turns back, his holster catches on the switchboard, and he fumbles briefly to free it. Benda asks if he ever uses the revolver. The doorman holds it up, still in the holster, and says he has never drawn it, adding that it’s only there because a rival company has them.
related_events: Doorman opens door for the Svibens
Kresimir requests assistance from the doorman

name: The Doorman's Interruption While Calling the Rental Agent
description: As the Svibens arrive at the building, the doorman stands and moves to the intercom switchboard to contact the rental agent. He reaches out to press a button, but his holster snags on the edge of the board. He pauses, tugs gently to free it, and then completes the action, pressing the button to signal the agent.
related_events: Doorman presses intercom button to contact Kresimir
Doorman's holster catches on intercom switchboard
Doorman frees his holster from the intercom board

name: Benda Asks About the Doorman's Revolver
description: As the doorman fumbles to free his holster from the intercom switchboard, Benda asks if he ever uses the revolver at his side. The doorman looks down at it and chuckles, saying he’s never drawn it. He explains it’s just something they have because rival companies carry them too, nothing more than an advertising gimmick.
related_events: Benda questions doorman about revolver usage
Doorman explains revolver as advertising gimmick

name: St. Luc Ends Call with Rollo and Confirms Meeting
description: St. Luc finishes his phone call with Rollo, confirming the meeting location as apartment 1009 in the South Tower of Starliner Towers. They agree to meet at ten. He hangs up and pushes his papers aside, leaning back in his swivel chair.
related_events: St. Luc finishes phone call with Rollo

name: Forsythe Invites St. Luc to Supper
description: Forsythe finishes dressing and waits for St. Luc to get off the phone. After he hangs up, she asks if he would like to come to her place for a late supper. St. Luc says he is meeting Rollo at Tudor's and might be busy for a while. Forsythe replies that it doesn't matter how late it gets—she can keep the meal warm. St. Luc pushes his papers aside and stretches in his chair. Forsythe asks if anything is wrong. He says no, he doesn't think so. She repeats her invitation. He agrees, but says it will be late. Forsythe, pleased, tells him to go back to his files and leaves, closing the door behind her. St. Luc sits quietly for a moment, swiveling in his chair, then turns back to his work.
related_events: Forsythe invites St. Luc to a late supper
St. Luc declines invitation due to prior engagement
Forsythe inquires about St. Luc's well-being
St. Luc agrees to Forsythe's supper invitation with condition

name: Forsythe Leaves, St. Luc Returns to Work
description: After Forsythe closes the door and leaves the room, St. Luc sits in his swivel chair and stretches, pushing his papers aside for a moment. He turns thoughtfully in the chair, then swings back to his desk and resumes working on his files.
related_events: Forsythe expresses satisfaction and departs
St. Luc pauses work and stretches in his chair
St. Luc reflects briefly before resuming work

name: St. Luc Reviews Tudor's File and Agrees to a Home Visit
description: St. Luc sits at his desk with Janine across from him, flipping through her husband Tudor's medical file. He points out that last year's check-up showed only slightly elevated blood pressure and low cholesterol, and he expresses doubt that cancer could have developed so quickly based on the symptoms Janine described. Janine, visibly tense but somewhat relieved, asks if he can come to the house to examine her husband. St. Luc agrees, saying he’ll need to close up the clinic and have supper first, and suggests arriving between 9:30 and 10:00. Janine nods, thanks him, and leaves. After she goes, St. Luc remains at his desk, staring at the file, shifting a document from one side to the other, still preoccupied. Forsythe appears at the door to an exam room and tells him Mrs. Ementhal is ready. He murmurs an acknowledgment, then turns his attention away from the file and toward the next patient.
related_events: St. Luc reviews Janine's husband's medical file
St. Luc expresses doubt about rapid cancer development
Janine requests a home visit for her husband
St. Luc agrees to a home visit in the evening

name: Janine Exits the Clinic After Consultation
description: Janine thanks the doctor, stands up, opens the door to the reception area, and leaves, closing the door behind her.
related_events: Janine leaves the clinic after the consultation

name: St. Luc Reviews Tudor's File Before Seeing Mrs. Ementhal
description: After Janine closes the door behind her, St. Luc remains at his desk, staring at Tudor's open file. He shifts a document from one side of the folder to the other, his expression thoughtful. The door to an examination room opens and Forsythe appears, calling out that Mrs. Ementhal is ready. St. Luc looks up, murmurs an acknowledgment, and tells her he will be there in a moment. Forsythe retreats, and St. Luc returns to the file, continuing to study it before finally closing it and preparing to leave.
related_events: St. Luc examines Tudor's medical file with concern
Forsythe informs St. Luc about Mrs. Ementhal's readiness
St. Luc delays joining Mrs. Ementhal

name: Merrick Shows the Elevator to the Svibens
description: In the elevator, Merrick stands with the rental agent and the Svibens. The doors close and the elevator begins to rise. Merrick says, 'We're going up.' Tudor replies, 'Oh. Well, I'll go along for the ride.' After a pause, Merrick gestures toward the elevator walls and says, 'Wood-grain paneling, strong, silent, fireproof, fast, cushioned ride. Everything you could want in an elevator.' No one speaks again until the doors open. Merrick winks at Tudor, then quickly guides the Svibens out into the hallway. As the doors close behind them, Merrick’s voice drifts back, still speaking to the Svibens: 'Notice how the entranceways to all the apartments are recessed and individually lit... Nope, it's down that way, Brenda. That's it... Recessed and individually lit...' Inside the elevator, Tudor waits until the doors shut, then presses the button for the top floor. He opens his wallet, reaches into a zippered compartment, and takes out a key.
related_events: Merrick demonstrates elevator features to the Svibens
Merrick signals Tudor with a wink before exiting
Merrick ushers the Svibens out of the elevator

name: Tudor Takes the Elevator to the Top Floor
description: After the elevator doors closed behind Merrick and the Svibens, Tudor pressed the button for the top floor. As the elevator began to rise, he opened his wallet and pulled a key from a zippered compartment inside.
related_events: Tudor presses the button for the top floor after the elevator door closes
Tudor retrieves a key from his wallet's zippered compartment during the elevator ascent

name: Tudor Joins Merrick and the Svibens in the Elevator
description: Tudor stands in the elevator as Merrick announces they are going up. After a brief pause, Tudor says, 'Oh. Well, I'll go along for the ride.' He steps in and the doors begin to close.
related_events: Tudor decides to join the elevator ride

name: Tudor Returns Home and Unwinds
description: Tudor enters his apartment and throws his jacket and attaché case onto a chair. He loosens his tie, walks to the kitchen, and pours himself a drink. Carrying the glass, he sits down on the sofa and switches on the television.
related_events: Tudor enters apartment and discards jacket and attaché case
Tudor loosens tie and prepares drink
Tudor sits on sofa and turns on television

name: Tudor Collapses and Recovers from Sudden Spasm
description: Tudor sits on the sofa and turns on the TV. After a short moment of stillness, he suddenly contracts into the fetal position, spilling his drink onto the floor. He rolls onto the floor, eyes wide, mouth opening and closing rapidly, tendons in his neck straining. After a time, he struggles back to his feet, hands clamped over his mouth, and stumbles toward the bathroom.
related_events: Tudor suffers sudden physical spasm and collapses
Tudor experiences severe physical symptoms
Tudor struggles back to his feet after spasm

name: Tudor Vomits and Collapses in Bathroom
description: Tudor stumbles into the bathroom, both hands clamped over his mouth. He drops to his knees beside the bathtub, leans over into the tub, and gags violently, vomiting a trail of blood-streaked slime that flows into the drain. Afterward, he collapses onto the bathroom floor, motionless, his mouth smeared with blood, breathing heavily.
related_events: Tudor stumbles into bathroom with hands over mouth
Tudor collapses on bathroom floor after vomiting

name: Hobbes Attacks Annabelle in a Violent Struggle
description: Dr. Emil Hobbes grabs Annabelle Horsefield and tries to strangle her. She fights back fiercely, and the two crash through the apartment, knocking over objects as they struggle. Annabelle breaks free and runs, with Hobbes chasing after her. She slips, and he tackles her, pinning her to the ground.
related_events: Dr. Emil Hobbes attempts to strangle Annabelle Horsefield
Annabelle Horsefield resists Hobbes during the assault
Annabelle breaks free and Hobbes chases her
Annabelle slips and Hobbes pins her to the ground

name: Hobbes Strangles Annabelle and Clamps Her Lips Shut
description: After pinning Annabelle to the ground, Hobbes tightened his grip around her throat with violent force, his face strained and tearful. She struggled fiercely, but he continued until blood began to seep from her mouth. He pressed his hand over her face, covering her mouth as she lay still. Then he reached toward his leather doctor's bag, scattered open on the floor, and pulled out a surgical clamp. He fastened it over her lips, closing them tightly. With her body limp, he lifted her and carried her across the room.
related_events: Hobbes strangles Annabelle with violent intensity
Hobbes covers Annabelle's mouth to suppress speech or emission
Hobbes retrieves surgical clamp from his doctor's bag
Hobbes clamps Annabelle's lips shut

name: Hobbes Places Annabelle on the Table and Undresses Her
description: Hobbes lifted Annabelle's body and carried it to the dining-room table. He swept the cups and bottles off the surface and laid her down with careful precision. Then he began to undress her, moving slowly and deliberately.
related_events: Hobbes moves Annabelle's body to the dining table
Hobbes begins undressing Annabelle's body

name: Janine Delivers News About Dr. St. Luc
description: Janine enters Betts' apartment and stands halfway in the doorway. Betts is sitting cross-legged on the broadloom, surrounded by large black-and-white photographs, which she arranges and rearranges as they speak. Janine tells her that Dr. St. Luc is coming to see Nick at around ten. Betts asks if he was nice, and Janine nods. Betts takes a sip from a glass beside her and mentions she has ordered French food for dinner.
related_events: Janine enters Betts' apartment and delivers a message about Dr. St. Luc's visit
Betts arranges and rearranges large black-and-white photographs on the floor

name: Betts Orders Dinner and Invites Janine to Join Later
description: Betts sits on the floor surrounded by photographs, a glass of drink beside her. She asks Janine if she wants a drink, and Janine declines. Betts mentions she has ordered French food from Jean-Philippe at the Côte d'Azur restaurant—escargots in garlic butter, coq au vin, the full meal. She talks about the delivery boys who bring the food through sleet and darkness. After mentioning that Dr. St. Luc is coming to see Nick, she tells Janine that if Nick falls asleep early, Janine should come back to her apartment for company and a late supper. She insists she always orders enough for two and says she’ll get fat and lonely if Janine doesn’t come.
related_events: Betts offers Janine a drink and mentions ordering French cuisine from a restaurant
Betts invites Janine to return for late supper and company

name: Janine Accepts Betts' Invitation
description: Janine stands in the doorway of Betts' apartment as Betts speaks. Betts tells her to come back after Dr. St. Luc’s visit for company and a late supper, insisting she always orders enough for two. Janine nods silently in response. Betts continues to arrange photographs on the floor as the conversation ends.
related_events: Janine nods in response to Betts' invitation

name: Dr. St. Luc Visits and Assesses Nick
description: Dr. St. Luc arrives at the apartment and examines Nick. After the evaluation, he tells Janine that Nick’s condition is not serious and suggests he would benefit from a vacation. Janine listens and accepts the doctor’s assessment.
related_events: Dr. St. Luc advises that Nick needs a vacation to recover

name: Kurt Meets the Old Woman in the Hallway
description: Kurt steps out of the elevator and pushes his cart down the hallway toward Betts's apartment. As he walks, he notices an old woman standing behind her slightly ajar door, partially hidden in the shadows. She calls out, 'I'm hungry!' Kurt keeps moving, but glances back at her. The old woman speaks again, repeating the same words, and slowly steps further into view. Kurt turns to look at her directly as he continues down the hall.
related_events: Kurt exits elevator and walks toward Betts's apartment

description: The ambulance crew pulled a sheet over Annabelle Horsefield's body and lifted it onto a stretcher in the quiet apartment. At the other end of the room, the building's superintendent spoke with a detective, confirming that the woman was Annabelle Horsefield, whose name was on the lease. St. Luc said he hadn’t. He explained that he had known Hobbes as a professor from medical school but had not seen him in years. That morning, Hobbes had called him twice, asking him to meet for lunch and saying it was time to further his education. Curious, St. Luc came to the apartment at noon. The door was open. He called out, found no response, and discovered both bodies on the floor. He checked for pulses but saw they were already dead. The apartment showed no signs of forced entry or struggle. The detective wrote down the details, then turned to the superintendent to ask about Hobbes’s income and behavior. After learning Hobbes had paid the rent on time and caused no issues, the detective closed his notebook and told St. Luc not to leave the island.
